products.name: PREMIUM ACID WASH OUT COLLAR TSHIRT
products.description:
Elevate your casual collection with this unique, multi-textured full-sleeve fancy polo t-shirt. Crafted from high-grade imported lycra, it provides superior softness, shape retention, and maximum 4-way stretch.
The highlight of this piece is its contrast acid-wash denim collar and shoulder panel inserts, giving it a distinct rugged-meets-stylish look. Finished with a bold "Believe" chest graphic and comfortable ribbed cuffs, it’s designed for modern men who want to stand out effortlessly. Perfect for casual outings, streetwear fashion, college, or weekend hangouts.
products.materialCare:
Main Fabric: Premium Imported Lycra Blend
Accent Fabric: Contrast Acid-Wash Denim Finish (Collar, Placket & Shoulder Panel)
Stretchability: 4-Way Stretch for flexible movement and shape retention
Feel & Texture: Soft, breathable, medium-weight premium feel
